collector.imports: Flatten UseTree leaves, including grouped paths, source-side renames and glob markers; do not visit use attributes or visibility. Rename target names are omitted.
collector.expressions: Every other visited syn::Path, including type, attribute, macro-invocation and generic paths; visibility paths are skipped. This is not an ExprPath-only or direct-call claim.
collector.inline_modules: Push the authored module identifier while visiting inline contents; external modules use the declared file owner.
collector.normalization: Strip r# for normalization; crate and rafter_invariants become crate; self extends the exact module owner, optionally popping subsequent super; leading super pops owners. Unrooted paths and over-climbing super return None. Import trailing self is removed.
collector.process_selection: Include Import crate itself and normalized crate::execution with at most two segments or third segment process. Do not include a bare crate expression or other execution subdomains.
collector.spelling: Compare original written segment vector to normalized vector for every selected occurrence. Semantic resolution is not claimed; alias targets are not resolved.
collector.macro_occurrences: Recursively inspect tokens for crate/rafter_invariants/self/super roots and colon-separated or grouped paths, preserving the original token scanner semantics; macro invocation paths are also ordinary visited paths.
collector.macro_ban: Recursively flatten identifiers, strip r#, ignore punctuation and literals, and reject a macro token group containing adjacent identifiers execution,process. Macro definitions and invocations both participate.
collector.crate_alias_ban: Every extern crate self or extern crate rafter_invariants declaration records its rename or the literal self when no rename is authored.
collector.quantities: Exact physical file/context/normalized-path tuples; no receiver identity, control-flow or execution claim.
